name: Linko
summary: Hand-shedding card game where melding cards scores points but higher matching melds steal opponents' stacks.
rules_text: Each player is dealt 13 cards from a deck of 8x1-13 plus 5 jokers. Six cards are laid face up as a row beside the draw pile. On your turn you may play one card or multiple cards of the same rank face-up onto your personal stack, overlapping previous cards. Jokers copy the rank they are played with, or count as 14 when alone. After playing, check each opponent clockwise once: if your count of cards played equals the count showing on top of their stack and your rank is higher, you snatch that top set. You choose to take it into your hand or not. If you take it, the victim draws that many cards from the row or deck. If you decline, the victim must either take the snatched cards back into hand or discard them and draw replacements. Row is refilled to six after all draws. First player to empty hand ends game, also ends if draw pile and row are empty. Score +1 per card in your stack, -1 per card in hand.
